messages:
jen liu: Quick check — I want to roll a config-only tweak in the quiet window tomorrow 03:00–04:00 PDT. Changes: reduce max_batch_size 64 -> 48, batching_window_ms 10 -> 8, request timeout 15s -> 18s, and add a regional fallback route. Planning to pin model version to v1.12 for 2h during the rollout. Anyone opposed?

samir: fine with numbers, what's the rollback plan if latency spikes?

jen liu: rollback = revert config and promote pinned routing back to v1.11. Playbook: immediate revert + abort ramps. Monitor p95 latency and error_rate; abort if p95 > 450ms sustained 5m or error_rate > 1%.

deploy-bot: config deploy queued by @jen_liu. PR: https://git.internal/r/redwood/configs/pulls/1327. Diff summary:
```
routes.default.routing_policy: latency_preferred -> cost_aware_with_fallback
batching.max_batch_size: 64 -> 48
batching.window_ms: 10 -> 8
timeouts.request_ms: 15000 -> 18000
pinned_model: 'model:open-llm-1.12'
```
Queued for change window: 2026-03-21T10:00:00Z (03:00 PDT).

emily: please add an explicit cache warmup on the canary for 10 minutes after deploy, and keep KV cache TTL at 1h.

matt s: noted. oncall will run synthetic traffic for the first 15 minutes and keep a canary at 5% traffic. I'll watch infra metrics.

oncall-sre: I'll be online for rollout. Please tag me when the deploy starts.

samir: also add a concise release note mentioning batching reduction + timeout bump and rationale (latency/cost tradeoff).

jen liu: added release_notes section in the PR body and linked the perf rationale. tagging @emily when canary starts.

deploy-bot: deploy started to canary (5%): deployment id deploy-2123456789-1. status: IN_PROGRESS. :rocket:

matt s: canary healthy at t+5m. p95 latency down ~30ms, error_rate unchanged.

emily: warmup done. checking KV hit rate — stable.

samir: monitoring for 10 more minutes then we'll decide ramp.

matt s: at t+20m, p95 spiked to 520ms for ~3m then recovered. no user impact observed. leaning to proceed but keep rollforward conservative.

jen liu: hold ramp to 20% for now, enable fallback routing to other regions at a 3% error spike threshold.

deploy-bot: ramped to 20%. status: OK.

oncall-sre: still watching, will alert if p95 > 450ms over 5m or error_rate > 1%.

samir: agreed, keep pin to v1.12 for 2 hours.

jen liu: thanks team — will follow up with a short postmortem if we hit the abort thresholds. :thumbsup:
